The change modifies the `UnsatisfiedRequirements` field in the `MatchResult` struct from `[]string` to `FeatureSet`. This type change will cause compilation failures in files that populate or consume this field, as they assume it is `[]string`.

The affected files are:

- `staging/src/k8s.io/component-helpers/nodedeclaredfeatures/framework.go` (populates the field with `[]string` in `MatchNodeFeatureSet`)
- `pkg/scheduler/framework/plugins/nodedeclaredfeatures/nodedeclaredfeatures.go` (consumes the field as `[]string` in `strings.Join`)
- `plugin/pkg/admission/nodedeclaredfeatures/admission.go` (consumes the field as `[]string` in `strings.Join`)
- `pkg/kubelet/lifecycle/handlers.go` (consumes the field as `[]string` in `strings.Join`)
